newsitem.title: USA: Diebold sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: Diebold sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: Diebold Inc said Thursday its board of directors declared a three-for-two stock split to be effected through a stock dividend.
The dividend will be payable on February 19 to shareholders of record February 7 and shareholders will receive one additional share for each two shares held on the record date, it said.
The stock split is the fourth stock split the company has declared in the past five years, it said.
In addition to the stock split, the board also declared a first-quarter cash dividend of 12.5 cents per share on all common shares.
The cash dividend is payable March 28 to shareholders of record on March 7. The dividend represents a 10.3 percent increase over the cash dividend paid in the past, it said.
It said it is the 44th consecutive year that Diebold has increased its cash dividend.
